name: squat_down
text: A person starts standing upright with both feet shoulder width apart. Slowly bend both knees and hips, lowering into a deep squat with heels on the ground. Move the arms forward slightly for balance. End in a stable low squat and stay there. One complete transition from standing to squatting, do not stand back up.
hand_target: separate wrists laterally to at least 0.38m where reachable, preserve individual hand orientation

review.notes_zh: 从直立缓慢下降至深蹲，最终停住，髋下降约71厘米；双手分开放在膝前，修正首版叠手。
